metadata.case_name: WONG TAI YAU v. TRANSWARD STEVEDORE LTD

plaintiff.occupation_after: stevedore for Everbest Port Services Ltd at the container port

injuries.description: comminuted intra-articular fracture of the proximal phalanx of the right thumb, namely, multiple fractures which extended into the articular area of the joints of the proximal phalanx.
source: X-ray examination showed comminuted intra-articular fracture of the proximal phalanx of the right thumb, namely, multiple fractures which extended into the articular area of the joints of the proximal phalanx.

manifestations.description: persistent pain of the right thumb
residual pain, tenderness, shortening, deformity, stiffness and weakness (assessed to be permanent)
metacarpophalangeal joint fused and could not move after surgery
reduced grip strength; difficulty lifting heavy objects
pain and discomfort during exertion and weather change—with difficulty in daily activities which require thumb action

treatments_received: treatment at Accident and Emergency Department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital
admission to Orthopaedic and Traumatology Department, Queen Elizabeth Hospital
initial conservative treatment by thumb splint
surgical operation in April 2005 for fusion of the metacarpophalangeal joint and debridement of the interphalangeal joint
physiotherapy (first session Feb to June 2004: ice therapy and magnetopulse therapy; later wax therapy and ultrasound; hand function training)
physiotherapy (second session after operation: ice with magnetopulse therapy; passive mobilization to the interphalangeal joint)
advice on home exercise (physiotherapy ceased August 2005)
treatments_future: intermittent symptomatic treatment for residual pain (assessed at $2,000 per year by court)

losses.description: Persistent pain, tenderness, shortening, deformity, stiffness and weakness of the right thumb; metacarpophalangeal joint fused and immobile; reduced grip strength and difficulty lifting heavy objects.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty in daily activities which require thumb action.
